methods.name: SendInk
methods.description: Send one sketched stroke for recognition, when the pen lifts (after SendPenDown). Use it to turn what a user draws, alone or with speech sent at about the same time (SendSpeechRecognition or SendSimulatedSpeechRecognition), into symbols, tasks, edits or commands; to place a fully specified symbol without recognition, use AddSymbol instead. methods.description: Convert a C2SIM XML document (for example an Initialization from PullC2SIMInitialization) into STP object_set([...]) text. NO PARENT COA: no COA is minted and no object carries a parent COA; a caller that needs COA-parented objects, to load them into a scenario say, must mint the COAs and parent the objects itself. Well-formed XML with nothing convertible returns an empty object_set([]); malformed XML or missing content is refused.

methods.name: GetC2SIMContent
methods.description: Export the current scenario, or the COAs listed in coaPoids, as a C2SIM XML document. dataType must be Initialization (units, tactical graphics and task org items) or Order (confirmed tasks); a missing, unknown or All value is refused. affiliation scopes the export to one side. options apply to this call only, and an unknown key is refused. Read-only: nothing changes in STP and nothing is sent - use PushC2SIMContent to send a document to a C2SIM server. Refused when there is nothing to export: no units, graphics or task org items for Initialization (as in a session with no scenario), or no confirmed tasks for Order (see ConfirmTask).

params.name: name
params.description: Name to associate with the generated content.

params.name: dataType
params.description: C2SIM data type to generate (engine-defined; parsed as StpRecognizer.C2CIMDataType).

params.name: affiliation
params.description: Affiliation to scope the generated content to.

params.name: coaPoids
params.description: Unique identifiers of the COAs to include.

params.name: options
params.description: Generation options. Applied to THIS CALL ONLY - options no longer persist into the engine's shared configuration, so nothing one caller passes affects any later call or any other session (STP-687). The key set is definite and enumerated below, NOT implementation-defined. An unknown or misspelled key fails the call with success = false and nothing applied, rather than being silently ignored. Keys are listed in the camelCase spelling clients send - the field names of the JS SDK's StpC2SIMOptions (for example restUrl) - so a strict, case-sensitive JSON Schema validator accepts what the SDK sends (STP-694). The engine itself compares key names CASE-INSENSITIVELY and also accepts any other casing of a listed key (restUrl, resturl and RESTURL set the same option). Three properties of the engine's configuration are deliberately NOT settable over the wire because they are not operator-settable either - stphost and stpport drive the engine's own long-lived connection, and backgroundmode is set by the host process.

restUrl.description: C2SIM REST endpoint, host:port/path, e.g. http://10.2.10.30:8080/C2SIMServer.

restPassword.description: C2SIM REST endpoint password. Applied to this call only; it is never stored.

stompUrl.description: STOMP endpoint, host:port/destination. Used to build this call's REST client; it does NOT move the engine's long-lived notification subscription.

systemName.description: Value of SystemEntityList/SystemName in the generated Initialization document.

resetBeforeInitialize.description: Force the C2SIM server to Uninitialized before pushing Initialization, so it is not merged with a previous one.

runAfterInitialize.description: Switch the C2SIM server to Running immediately after pushing Initialization.

fullTO.description: Include the full Task Org, including entities not placed on the map. When false, only placed elements and their subordinates.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version hint (1.0.0 / 1.0.1 / 1.0.2). All inputs generate 1.0.2 unified output.

addOrphanTgToInitialization.description: Include tactical graphics that are not part of any task in the Initialization document.

placeAllTgInInitialization.description: Place tactical graphics in the Initialization document instead of the Order document.

includeMapGraphicId.description: Include MapGraphicID references to tactical graphics in tasks, rather than relying on Location.

entityNameCharLimit.description: Maximum number of characters in a generated entity name; 0 for no limit.

includeDescriptionInName.description: Append the description to generated entity names - required to round-trip an ORBAT imported from C2SIM documents.

rulesOfEngagement.description: Default rules of engagement. The value is matched CASE-SENSITIVELY against the engine's ROE members, unlike the key; any other value (for example the pre-0.6.17 SDK spellings ROEHold / ROEFree / ROETight) is not applied - the engine logs a warning and keeps its configured default.

updateUnitPositions.description: Use Position Report information to update units. ACCEPTED BUT INERT for a single call: it is read only by the engine's inbound report handler, which has no per-call context.

validationSchema.description: Path to a schema file to validate generated XML against; empty for no validation.

startDate.description: Mission start date. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

phaseDuration.description: Duration of each STP phase, in minutes.

unknownFstName.description: Unknown forces name. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

unknownFstUUID.description: Unknown forces unique id. ACCEPTED BUT INERT: nothing in the C2SIM bridge reads it.

methods.name: ImportCoaFromObjectSet
methods.description: Import a COA from a JSON array of STP objects; the object-set form of ImportCoaContent. Send the objects as GetCoaObjectSet returned them: each object's PrologTerm, the string holding its STP text, is its content, and typed fields sent beside it win over the text. Poids are kept exactly as they are in the objects; no new ids are generated. An object in the content whose poid already exists in the scenario REPLACES the resident object (its previous version stays in the undo history); objects not in the content are left alone, and a content object carrying the deletion version (dbVersion v0; such a marker needs no PrologTerm) deletes that poid - a poid the scenario never had too, which is not an error and is announced as deleted. Returns the poid of the first coa object (null when there is none; an empty array imports nothing). Refused before anything is applied, with the object named: an object without PrologTerm (a deletion marker aside), a PrologTerm in the array form older engines returned, PrologTerm text that is not an object, and an entry that is not an object (null, a string). The objects are applied one at a time, not all-or-nothing: when the engine rejects one, the load stops there and answers success false naming that object and why, the objects applied before it (they stay applied and were announced), any rejected and skipped on the way, and those not applied. A load cut off by the request timeout ends without that report. Engines before STP-1090 refuse the verbatim GetCoaObjectSet output as unreadable (engines before STP-1088 never answer) and import objects without PrologTerm with empty fields; with those, use ImportCoaContent with GetCoaContent text instead.

methods.name: PullC2SIMInitialization
methods.description: Fetch the C2SIM Initialization document (for example the order of battle) from the external C2SIM server named by options (restUrl; the engine's configured server when omitted) and return it as XML. Only the XML comes back; the server status is not returned over this API. Nothing is loaded into the STP scenario: convert it with ConvertC2SIMContent and import the result if you want it there.
